text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened several dozen minutes before training began...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looks like my body has warmed up. If I turn back from here and head to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, miss! Come check out our shop!
We've got all sorts of cute imported trinkets~!

text_block_list.name: Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
"Like this tie clip!
Hmm~ I'd love to see a stylish older lady
rock this!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. You're quite the smooth talker. But a tie clip, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (Oh? This might go well with Trainer's suit. It'd add a nice touch of effortless style, too.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's fashion theme was supposed to be "A Trustworthy Trainer"—having an item like this wouldn't hurt, right?)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Though for Trainer,
a slightly calmer vermilion might be better... Hmm~)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Are these all the goods you have on display?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, North Flight failed to return to the academy
by the scheduled time, ending up skipping training...
